run_truncate_videos: run the truncate_videos CLI to process all MP4 and MOV files in a folder
run_truncate_videos_with_frames: run truncate_videos with custom frame count and resolution for video fine-tuning
run_truncate_videos_force_upsample: run truncate_videos with force_upsample flag to upscale videos below target resolution
run_truncate_videos_copy_captions: run truncate_videos to crop videos and copy or create empty caption .txt files alongside
run_truncate_videos_subclip_crop: run truncate_videos to subclip videos to a duration, center-crop to aspect ratio, and resize
